criteria.name: A2c-1  net displacement is flat while circulation grows
criteria.detail: gradient magnitude stays within a factor of 1.62; total flow grows x97.1

criteria.name: A2c-2  the churn ratio rises by an order of magnitude
A2c-3  the harmonic component is diluted, not removed
criteria.detail: magnitude within a factor of 1.65 while its share falls 2.18e-02 -> 8.59e-07. Reporting the share alone would have said it vanished

criteria.name: A2c-4  cycle rank collapses with no edge deleted
criteria.detail: potential rank 2846, realized fraction 0.029, and the potential graph is identical throughout

criteria.name: A2c-5  one autonomous edge restores most of the loop structure
A2c-6  the collapse and the rescue hold across graph seeds
A2c-7  limitation recorded: cycle rank saturates when nothing dies
criteria.detail: in the two-layer model the realized rank is flat at 1074 after the transient, against a potential 1190. Cycle rank is a binary count, so it moves only where edges drop out of the realized graph. It is informative in the three-layer economy and inert in the two-layer one, and this criterion exists to keep that on the record

definitions.realized graph: a directed edge is in it when the flow across it in that round exceeds the cutoff; cycle rank is taken on the underlying undirected graph
definitions.cutoff: 1e-4 of the mean flow per potential edge at round 0, fixed for the run (NetworkHistory.epsilon_absolute)
definitions.positive_rank: cycle rank counting every edge whose flow is a positive floating-point number, however small
definitions.decades_of_cutoff_reading_this_graph: log10 of the smallest flow above the cutoff minus log10 of the largest flow at or below it; no flow lies between, so every cutoff in that band reads the same realized graph
definitions.flow_norm, 'total flow', 'circulation': the Euclidean norm of net flow per undirected edge of the realized graph, flow[i, j] - flow[j, i]; it is not gross volume, which is recorded beside it
definitions.harmonic, every triangle filled: the part of net flow orthogonal to the gradient and to every triangle's boundary; A2c-3 is read on this
definitions.harmonic, no face filled: everything orthogonal to the gradient, which is the curl part and the harmonic part of the other split added together
definitions.continuation: the same arm, seed and configuration run to CONTINUE_ROUNDS instead of the registered length; it reproduces the registered run at every snapshot the two share
definitions.growth_of_the_ratio_to_the_gradient_norm: a measure of flow over the gradient norm at the last snapshot, divided by the same at the first; on net_flow_per_edge_norm this is A2c-2's ratio_end over ratio_start
definitions.round: a unit of trend, not a calendar period
